categories.main_business_segments: Korea Real Estate Investment & Trust Co., Ltd primarily operates in real estate trust services including land trust, urban redevelopment, REITs, investment, and ancillary services. The company also engages in collateral trust, management trust, disposition trust, sales management trust, agency services, and consulting. Its subsidiary, Koreit Asset Management, focuses on asset management including collective investment, investment advisory, and investment discretionary services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes trust-based legal frameworks to manage and develop real estate assets, combining client assets with company capital and expertise for development projects. It employs specialized trust structures such as borrowing-type and management-type land trusts, urban redevelopment trusts, and REIT asset management. The company also uses project financing and structured finance techniques for real estate development and investment. Asset management subsidiary applies diversified portfolio management techniques across stocks, bonds, real estate, and alternative assets including NPLs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are real estate owners, redevelopment and reconstruction associations, investors in real estate projects, and institutional investors in REITs. The company serves the real estate development, urban redevelopment, and investment markets, including public and private sectors. Its asset management subsidiary serves investors seeking diversified investment products including real estate, stocks, bonds, and alternative assets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea, with headquarters in Seoul and projects concentrated in Seoul, the metropolitan area, and major cities nationwide. Urban redevelopment projects are located in key districts of Seoul and surrounding regions. The asset management subsidiary also operates domestically with no significant foreign operations reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Korea Real Estate Investment & Trust Co., Ltd operates primarily midstream and downstream in the real estate value chain, acting as a trustee and asset manager responsible for development, management, and disposition of real estate assets. It intermediates between landowners, developers, construction firms, and investors, managing project financing and asset operations. The asset management subsidiary operates downstream by managing investment funds and portfolios on behalf of investors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses strategically on expanding urban redevelopment projects, diversifying revenue through REITs and investment businesses, and enhancing risk management amid market uncertainties. It is exploring new business areas such as waste disposal facility trusts to broaden its trust product scope. The asset management subsidiary is expanding into alternative investments including environmental infrastructure and NPLs, while adapting to changing financial markets with new fund products and client-tailored strategies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through trust fees from land development trusts, urban redevelopment trusts, collateral trusts, and sales management trusts. Additional income comes from asset management fees, investment gains, interest income from trust accounts, and consulting fees. The asset management subsidiary earns fees from collective investment management, advisory services, and securities trading profits.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest real estate trust companies in South Korea by capital, market share, and expertise, competing with other major trust firms such as KB Real Estate Trust, Daehan Land Trust, Kyobo Asset Trust, and Korea Asset Trust. It holds a leading market share in trust fees and urban redevelopment projects, maintaining a strong competitive position through diversified services and scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported total assets of approximately 1.89 trillion KRW and revenues of about 270 billion KRW, with a 26.9% increase in operating income but a 41.4% decrease in operating profit due to higher costs. The asset management subsidiary manages assets totaling around 2.2 trillion KRW with revenues of 32.7 billion KRW and a strong ROE of 32.2%. The company has shown steady growth in trust assets under management and maintains solid capital adequacy ratios.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive real estate trust services combining financial expertise, development know-how, and risk management to deliver stable returns to clients. Its differentiated value lies in its scale, diversified trust product portfolio including urban redevelopment and REITs, and ability to manage complex projects with professional execution. The asset management subsidiary provides diversified investment solutions across traditional and alternative asset classes, leveraging market insights and tailored strategies to meet investor needs.
